title: AML Detective: The KYC Files
intro: You are Lead Detective Riley, investigating layered transactions tied to shell companies. Follow AML controls, validate KYC evidence, and stop the laundering network.

cases.title: The Structuring Pattern
cases.scenario: A retail customer makes 12 cash deposits just below the reporting threshold across different branches in 3 days. What should you do first?

choices.text: File an internal alert, aggregate linked transactions, and escalate for potential SAR review.
choices.explanation: Correct. Structuring indicators require aggregation and escalation under AML monitoring procedures.

choices.text: Ignore the activity because each deposit is below threshold.
choices.explanation: Not correct. Threshold avoidance is a core red flag and should not be dismissed.

choices.text: Close the account immediately without documenting rationale.
choices.explanation: Not correct. Action must be evidence-based and documented through compliance workflow.

cases.success_summary: You connected the deposits and preserved evidence for the AML investigations team.
cases.failure_summary: The suspect kept exploiting branch fragmentation while the red flags went unreported.

cases.title: Beneficial Ownership Mismatch
cases.scenario: A newly onboarded import/export company lists a nominee director, but payment instructions route to an unrelated offshore entity. What is the strongest next step?

choices.text: Refresh KYC, verify beneficial ownership, and apply enhanced due diligence before processing high-risk transfers.
choices.explanation: Correct. Ownership inconsistencies and offshore routing require refreshed KYC and enhanced due diligence.

choices.text: Accept the instructions to avoid customer friction.
choices.explanation: Not correct. Customer convenience cannot override AML obligations.

choices.text: Wait until annual review cycle to investigate.
choices.explanation: Not correct. Material KYC discrepancies demand immediate risk-based action.

cases.success_summary: You exposed the hidden controller and blocked a likely layering route.
cases.failure_summary: The network moved funds before controls were tightened, creating regulatory exposure.
